name: logs-200
notes: Pins the capture contract: a ring is attached, three lines are logged (one carrying a PII sample), limit=2 returns the two newest. The fixture cannot assert line text (capture times vary and the harness has no substring assertion); the Go test asserts newest-first order, total_captured=3, and that no returned line contains the raw PII sample while the redacted placeholder is present.
recorded_from: mock-upstream: no upstream exists for this endpoint — the handler reads the attached server-log capture ring; recorded_response is the placeholder the harness schema requires, not a replayed upstream reply
